scope: English for Vietnamese A0-B1 knowledge research
notice: Research registry only. Re-check upstream terms before ingestion; this is not legal advice.

sources.name: Council of Europe CEFR / Companion Volume
sources.productionUse: Use communicative descriptors and terminology as framework reference; do not infer official word-level CEFR certification.

sources.name: CEFR-J Wordlist Version 1.6
sources.rights: Copyright Tono Laboratory, TUFS; research and commercial use stated as free with proper acknowledgement.
sources.productionUse: Primary A1-B1 lemma/POS level prior; preserve release, row identity and citation.

sources.name: CEFR-J Grammar Profile
sources.rights: Research/commercial use with citation per repository terms; copyright Tono Laboratory, TUFS.
sources.productionUse: Normalize selected A1-B1 grammar items manually; retain original code/version and review translations/notes.

sources.name: New General Service List
sources.rights: Project states lists are free to use including commercially; capture exact per-list Creative Commons terms before ingest.
sources.productionUse: Usefulness signal only, not CEFR authority.

sources.name: Open English WordNet 2025
sources.productionUse: Filter to selected curriculum and human-review learner-facing definitions/relations; retain attribution.

sources.name: PanLex
sources.rights: PanLex Database snapshots, Lite and Swadesh lists released CC0 1.0.
sources.productionUse: English-Vietnamese equivalence candidates only; human sense review required before creating Vietnamese teaching text.

sources.name: CMU Pronouncing Dictionary
sources.rights: Broad use/copy/modify/distribute permission subject to notices; acknowledgement requested.
sources.productionUse: Wait for an approved pronunciation schema/API instead of overloading existing fields.

sources.name: Mozilla Common Voice
sources.rights: CC0 dataset with current Mozilla Data Collective terms including no identity attempts and no re-host/re-share requirement.
sources.productionUse: Research/model evaluation only until learner-facing audio redistribution is explicitly cleared.

sources.name: English Vocabulary Profile / English Grammar Profile
sources.productionUse: Human validation of ambiguous level decisions; no bulk scrape/import.

sources.name: EFLLex
sources.productionUse: Research comparison only; no production commercial dataset ingestion.

sources.name: ICNALE
sources.rights: Terms prohibit reproducing or redistributing part or all of the data.
sources.productionUse: Use published aggregate research findings only; never ship learner texts.

sources.name: EF-Cambridge Open Language Database
sources.rights: Academic private study/non-commercial research licence; derivatives tightly controlled.
sources.productionUse: Research literature only.

sources.name: Wiktionary via Wiktextract / Kaikki
sources.rights: Wiktextract parser code licence does not replace Wiktionary content licences; content is share-alike/GFDL governed.
sources.productionUse: Later enrichment after share-alike/provenance review.

sources.name: Tatoeba
sources.rights: Default sentence redistribution CC BY 2.0; CC0 applies only to eligible original sentences; translations/audio require item-specific handling.
sources.productionUse: Per-record candidate examples later; first pack uses original LINGUA-authored sentences.

sources.name: UniMorph English
sources.productionUse: Later form validation; first pack prefers deterministic/manual forms.

sources.name: ConceptNet
sources.productionUse: Do not use as authoritative prerequisite graph; optionally research offline candidates later.

sources.name: SyntagNet
sources.productionUse: Non-commercial restriction; do not ingest into production.

sources.name: LanguageTool
sources.productionUse: Optional authoring QA tool only, never curriculum authority or core runtime dependency.

sources.name: wordfreq
sources.rights: Code Apache-2.0; bundled frequency data CC BY-SA 4.0 with multiple upstream attribution obligations.
sources.productionUse: Avoid copying/exporting its data into the catalog; use a cleaner source path.

sources.name: Leipzig Corpora Collection
sources.rights: General query data has non-commercial limits; downloadable text corpora are stated CC BY. Source-specific provenance still requires review.
sources.productionUse: Possible aggregate co-occurrence research later; not first learner-facing sentence source.

sources.name: Universal Dependencies English-EWT
sources.rights: Annotation dataset share-alike; underlying texts have mixed provenance.
sources.productionUse: Use to inform deterministic complexity features/evaluation, not to republish source sentences.
